_comment: The branch row and its cities, hand-written because this deployment has no database. Mirrors the shape lib/static-data.js hands to branchTokens() and the chrome. Everything a trading business would have — phone, email, WhatsApp, hours, reviews — is null ON PURPOSE: EVS has not opened in Iraq, and a placeholder is how a Business Profile gets suspended on the day the real one is claimed.

branch.name: EVS Iraq
branch._country_name_the: English says 'in Iraq', not 'in the Iraq', so country_the equals country and this stays null — branchTokens() falls back to country_name. Compare 'the UAE', which does need it.

_cities_comment: ONE CITY, AND THAT IS THE POINT. Bahrain listed six because the island is 780 km² and a single workshop genuinely reaches all of it. Iraq is 438,000 km²: Basra is 550 km from Baghdad and Erbil 350 km, so a Baghdad centre does NOT serve them and {{areas}} must not say it does. Basra and Erbil are discussed in the body copy as the separate markets they are, with no claim of premises. Add a city here only when there is a workshop in it.
